facts.text: deploys go out from the release/ember branch
every log line must be JSON lines (one object per line)
the quiet_retry feature flag defaults to off
commit subjects stay under 50 characters, imperative mood
the assistant will bring the cache-key rotation checklist once the release freeze ends

restart_wake.how: the harness process is SIGKILLed at a turn boundary and cold-restarted

long_gap.how: told in the text (three weeks away); S6a runs on wall time

turns.user: Morning. I'm starting the tidewater shipper rewrite today and want you as my pair for the next few weeks.
turns.assistant: Happy to pair on it. Tell me how the pieces fit and I'll keep track as we go.

turns.user: Quick environment notes first: staging Postgres listens on port 6432, not the default.
turns.assistant: Noted: staging Postgres is on 6432. I'll use that whenever we touch the staging database.

turns.user: And deploys only ever go out from the release/ember branch. Never from main.
turns.assistant: Understood. Deploys come from release/ember only, never from main.

turns.user: First task: sketch the module layout for the new shipper.
turns.assistant: Proposed layout: cli/, spool/, transport/, and config/, with spool owning the on-disk queue.

turns.user: Good enough for day one. Let's stop here.
turns.assistant: Sounds good. Next time we can start on the spool.

turns.user: Back on the spool. One constraint I forgot: CI runs on Python 3.12 only, so no 3.13 syntax.
turns.assistant: Got it: CI is Python 3.12 only. I'll keep the code to 3.12 features.

turns.user: Also, every log line we emit must be JSON lines, one object per line. Ops parses them.
turns.assistant: Understood: all logging is JSON lines, one object per line.

turns.user: The quiet_retry feature flag should default to off until ops signs it off.
turns.assistant: Noted: quiet_retry defaults to off.

turns.user: Write me the spool's append path in outline.
turns.assistant: Outline: open the segment, append a length-prefixed record, fsync on the batch boundary, rotate at 64 MB.

turns.user: Fine. That's it for today.
turns.assistant: Talk soon. Next up is the transport retry loop.

turns.user: Style rule before we commit anything: commit subjects stay under 50 characters, imperative mood.
turns.assistant: Noted: commit subjects under 50 characters, imperative mood.

turns.user: We're entering a release freeze. After it ends I need to rotate the cache signing key, and I'll forget.
turns.assistant: I'll bring the cache-key rotation checklist when we meet after the freeze ends.

turns.user: Draft a commit subject for the spool work.
turns.assistant: Suggested subject: "Add length-prefixed spool append".

turns.user: Now the transport retry loop: exponential backoff, capped.
turns.assistant: Backoff starts at 200 ms, doubles to a 30 s cap, with full jitter and a retry budget per batch.

turns.user: Good. Done for today.
turns.assistant: Done. The retry loop is ready for review next time.

turns.user: Reviewing the retry loop. Does it respect the quiet_retry flag?
turns.assistant: Yes: with quiet_retry off, every retry logs a warn line; with it on, only the final failure logs.

turns.user: Make the warn lines match our logging rule.
turns.assistant: They are emitted as single JSON objects, one per line.

turns.user: What should the integration test target?
turns.assistant: The staging database on port 6432 and a stub collector.

turns.user: Add a test for the backoff cap.
turns.assistant: Added: a test asserting no sleep exceeds 30 s across 12 retries.

turns.user: Wrap up.
turns.assistant: Wrapped. Tests are green locally.

turns.user: Heads-up: ops moved staging Postgres to port 6543 this morning. The old 6432 port is gone.
turns.assistant: Thanks. Staging Postgres is now on 6543; I'll stop using 6432.

turns.user: Update the integration test config accordingly.
turns.assistant: Updated: the integration test now targets port 6543.

turns.user: Sorry, my machine crashed and I had to restart everything. Where were we?
turns.assistant: We had just moved the integration tests to staging port 6543 after ops changed it.

turns.user: Right. Next: config loading from a TOML file.
turns.assistant: Config loads from tidewater.toml, with env vars overriding keys.

turns.user: Enough for today.
